h:
使用 ComfyUI 有时，Lora 的文件名会导致正面提示出现问题。例如，<洛拉：Frieren_Pony：1.0>将被解释为朋友小马即使您无意使用文件名作为提示的一部分。

解决方案（除了重命名 Lora 之外）是使用 ComfyRoll 的 CR LoRA Stack！

.

在下载的 zip 文件中，您将找到展示中每个图像的 json！

不幸的是，这个工作流程的问题是没有可供 CivitAI 识别的 Lora 元数据。如果您想要一个可以做到这一点的工作流程，您可以查看我的其他工作流程：https://civitai.com/models/562659/

这不是关于如何设置 ComfyUI 的教程（那里有很多教程）。

安装要求

1. 舒适UI

2.ComfyUI-管理器-https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

3. 舒适卷 -https://github.com/Suzie1/ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes

o.en:
With ComfyUI sometimes the filename of a Lora causes problems in the positive prompt. For example,<lora:Frieren_Pony:1.0>will be interpreted asFrieren Ponyeven though it wasn't your intent to use the file name as part of the prompt.

The solution (other than renaming the Lora) is to use ComfyRoll's CR LoRA Stack!

.

In the download zipfile you will find a json for each image in the showcase!

Unfortunately the problem with this Workflow is that there is no Lora metadata for CivitAI to recognize. If you want a workflow that can do that you can checkout my other workflow:https://civitai.com/models/562659/

This isn't a tutorial on how to setup ComfyUI (there are plenty of tutorials out there).

Install Requirements

1. ComfyUI

2. ComfyUI-Manager -https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

3. ComfyRoll -https://github.com/Suzie1/ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes
